sources.title: Manage your money together with joint accounts!
Monzo Joint Account: Opening, Switching and Credit Scores

brands.evidence: Yes, you can open a joint account with Monzo in the UK.

client_claims.text: You can open a Monzo joint account in the UK with anyone you like, such as a partner, friend or flatmate.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover joint accounts.

client_claims.text: Both owners need UK residency, to be 18 or over, and need photo ID.
Both of you get a debit card, and the joint account has its own unique account number.
With a joint account overdraft, either of you can change the limits, make repayments or switch it off at any time.
You can set up Joint Instant Access Savings Pots if you have a joint account.
client_claims.note: Facts give the individual free plan rate only, not joint savings.

client_claims.text: Monzo plans are Extra, Perks and Max.
client_claims.note: Plan names match; no prices quoted.

client_claims.text: Paid plan users get virtual cards, advanced roundups, custom categories and auto-spreadsheets on a joint account.
client_claims.note: Plan features not covered by facts.

client_claims.text: Opening a joint account creates a financial association, and missed payments can affect both credit scores.
